title: Why Geralt of Rivia's hair turned white in The Witcher 3
subject: geralt
description:
Would you have survived the Trial of the Grasses? 👇

How a boy given away by his mother became Geralt of Rivia, the White Wolf. Spoilers for The Witcher saga lore.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by CD PROJEKT RED. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: His own mother gave Geralt away before he could remember her.
The sorceress Visenna left him at Kaer Morhen, where witchers trained boys to hunt monsters.
Most boys didn't survive the Trial of the Grasses, a ritual of mutagens.
Geralt endured it so well that the witchers kept experimenting on him.
But that's not the strangest part. Those extra mutations drained the color from his hair.
Even his name is borrowed: he was never from Rivia, and he faked the accent to seem trustworthy.
The White Wolf began with a mother who walked away.
